lines.text: The word of the LORD came to Micah the Moreshite in the days of Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah.
The LORD comes down to tread on the high places, and the mountains melt beneath Him like wax.
Samaria will become a heap of rubble in the open field, a planting area for a pasture.
Calamity came down from the LORD to the gate of Jerusalem, and Hebron was the beginning of sin to Zion.
The people are told to shave themselves bald in mourning, for their precious children will go into exile.
